plan: SEO & Page Indexing Strategy for GR Cup

tasks.title: Fix index.html — language, meta tags, Open Graph, Twitter Card
tasks.description: Update the HTML document: change lang to 'es', add comprehensive meta description, add og:title/description/type/url, add twitter:card, add robots meta, improve page title to include keywords. Also add Schema.org JSON-LD (SportsEvent + Organization + WebSite). Read the current file first.

tasks.title: Create robots.txt
tasks.description: Create robots.txt that allows all crawlers, blocks /backoffice/*, and points to sitemap.xml at the root URL. Language: Spanish/English comments.

tasks.title: Create sitemap.xml
tasks.description: Create static sitemap.xml with all public routes: /, /inscripcion, /horarios, /como-llegar, /raffle, /privacy, /terms, /consentimiento-datos, /politica-concurso. Use proper XML format with <loc>, <lastmod>, <changefreq>, <priority> tags. Priority: 1.0 for /, 0.8 for /inscripcion and /horarios, 0.6 for others.

tasks.title: Create dynamic Head/meta management system
tasks.description: Create a Head component (using Preact) that manages document title and meta tags dynamically per route. The component should accept: title, description, ogImage, canonicalUrl props. Add a default export. Use useEffect to update document.title and inject/update meta tags in <head>. Also create a metaConfig.ts file with per-page configurations for all public routes: Home (/), Inscripcion (/inscripcion), Horarios (/horarios), Location (/como-llegar), Raffle (/raffle), legal pages.

tasks.title: Integrate Head component into all public routes
tasks.description: Add the Head component to all public route pages. Read each file and add <Head> with appropriate title and description from the metaConfig. Ensure each page has unique, keyword-rich titles and descriptions. Read the metaConfig.ts to get the configuration values.

tasks.title: Add Organizers & Sponsors content section to Home
tasks.description: Enhance the OrganizationEquipmentSection to include an organized/organizadores section that naturally mentions: AEP (Asociación Española de Powerlifting), PowerHispania, and equipment brands SBD, A7. Also add Nico GR if applicable. Include proper semantic HTML (h2/h3 tags, lists). This creates natural keyword anchor text. Read the file first.

tasks.title: Update site.webmanifest with full SEO metadata
tasks.description: Update site.webmanifest to include: proper description mentioning 'powerlifting competition Spain', correct theme_color matching the brand, add categories array ['sports', 'events'], add related_applications if applicable, ensure icons are properly configured.

tasks.title: Create backend sitemap endpoint with dynamic lastmod
tasks.description: Create a new minimal API endpoint GET /api/sitemap that returns the sitemap XML dynamically. The sitemap should include all public pages with lastmod dates sourced from database (if available) or current date. Endpoint should return content-type text/xml. This allows the sitemap to stay updated automatically. Register the endpoint in Program.cs. Read Program.cs first to understand endpoint registration pattern.

tasks.title: Add JSON-LD structured data per page
tasks.description: Add dynamic JSON-LD structured data to the Home page: SportsEvent schema with name 'GR Cup 2026', location, startDate, description with powerlifting keywords, offers (ticket info), and organizer info. Also add WebSite schema with potentialAction (SearchAction). Inject via a <script type='application/ld+json'> tag in the component. Use useMemo for the schema object. Read the file first.
